title: Price Adjustments Mismatch Details
description: Recommended details shape for an INVALID_REQUEST that rejects a buyer-supplied pricing whose fixed_price or price_breakdown differs from the price the selected option's price_adjustments table resolves to for the purchase's selections and flight. Carries the resolved values so the buyer can see which row it disagrees on. Experimental (media_buy.price_adjustments).

resolved_fixed_price.description: The price the table resolves to for this purchase.

resolved_price_breakdown.description: The resolved breakdown: declared adjustments followed by one entry per fired row.
